test_policy.notes: SAT/ACT optional with a weighted GPA of 2.8 or above (4.0 scale). Students below 2.8 must submit ACT 17+ or SAT 930+. Stated for 2026-27 and beyond. Scores are one factor among many.

requirements.notes: Fee waiver via school counselor. One recommendation from a core-academic teacher; international page also requires a secondary school official report (not from a private counseling company/agent) and official transcript with English translation. A personal essay is required. Fee, teacher letter and counselor report as listed on the international first-year page.

deadlines.label: Early Action (non-binding)
deadlines.notes: Decisions by Dec 20 for North Carolina residents, by Feb 15 for all others. Supporting materials and test scores due Nov 7.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision
deadlines.notes: Supporting materials due Feb 15 per the international page (the domestic first-year page says Feb 21).

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required for non-US citizens/non-permanent residents. Waived if you will have lived in a country where English is the primary language, or attended a school with English as the primary language of instruction, for at least the last four years (including the current year) before enrolling. English-course grades and SAT/ACT do not qualify.

english.notes: Typical strong score for exams before Jan 21, 2026 (benchmark, not a minimum). Home Edition accepted.
Benchmark (not a minimum) for exams on or after Jan 21, 2026 (new scale).
C1 Advanced benchmark; C2 Proficiency accepted with no listed score

aid.notes: UNC states international students are not eligible for need-based aid and are not considered for academic scholarships; they must be self-funded for their entire studies.

toefl.note: UNC's English-proficiency page lists 'TOEFL (code C182)'. Confirm in your ETS account before sending. SAT/ACT codes not found.

tier_notes.business: Kenan-Flagler is a top-10 undergraduate business program.
tier_notes.nursing: School of Nursing is a top-5 undergraduate nursing program.
tier_notes.engineering: No engineering college; only biomedical engineering, run jointly with NC State.
